faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 is a notification released by the Department of Community Medicine, AIIMS Nagpur, to fill 3 temporary project-based positions under an ICMR-sponsored clinical trial project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across three different post designations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur project posts?
faq.answer: The last date to upload the application form and supporting documents is 17 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications for Project Research Scientist - I (Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/BVSc/BDS degree to be eligible for the Project Research Scientist - I (Medical) post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Project Technical Support – II posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years for the Project Technical Support – II (Field investigator and Lab Technician) posts, subject to government rule relaxations.
